_help: The people standing in the lands. Their places, looks and lines are read from your game (imported data/people.json); this file adds to them. talk_range: how near you must stand (pixels) to talk with A. heroes: names whose lines are the player's own (left out). names: a name for people of a sprite set the game never names. quiet: what people say when the game gives them nothing (by name, or 'default'). lines: replace one person's lines - key 'MAP:N' (N = their number on that map, from 0). hide: people to leave out ('MAP:N'). add: new people per map, {x, y, set, name, lines} in pixels of that map. fix_names: a name the game's text marks oddly -> the right one. looks: a sprite set that is always this person (a hero's look never takes the name in a line beside it).

default: Be careful out there - strange fighters have been seen around here.
They say the strong ones gather where the land gets wild.
NAMEK: Please, bring the others home safely too.
